_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for nerf-when, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 24 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). rules: a detachment rule's Damage-tab calcMods (hand). units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), its weapon footnotes (mods), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01) and stats values a rule of the list gives that New Recruit's export does not show. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

assault-brethren/armour-of-contempt.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
assault-brethren/armour-of-contempt.def: their Shooting phase or the Fight phase: -1 AP to attacks that target it (until that enemy unit has attacked)

assault-brethren/gene-wrought-might.gist: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight: its melee attacks have [LANCE]; or, if the assault doctrine is active for it, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

mod.note: [LANCE] (or, if the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP)

assault-brethren/duty-in-death.gist: Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: when a model of it is destroyed before your unit has been selected to fight, roll one D6 (+1 if the assault doctrine is active for it); on a 4+ that model is removed only when your unit has fought or at the end of the phase.
assault-brethren/duty-in-death.def: Fight phase, before it has been selected to fight: a destroyed model stays on a D6 of 4+ (+1 with the assault doctrine active) until it has fought or the end of the phase

terminator-storm-force/tactical-dreadnou.def: their Shooting phase or the Fight phase: -1 D to attacks that target it (until that enemy unit has attacked)

calcMods.when: Furor Tactics (the devastator doctrine is active for your unit)
Malleus Tactics (the tactical doctrine is active for your unit)

Leader of Astartes.def: Lone Operative while within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit

mods.when: Codex Adept (the devastator doctrine is active for this unit)

aura.note: re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1

roboute-guilliman.why: Codex Adept: the devastator doctrine is active for this unit (its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]). Primarch of the XIII (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6", his own unit included (22.01).

Bladeguard.def: Bladeguard (once per turn, in the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets it, instead of +1 to hit for its own melee attacks): attacks that target it have -1 to hit rolls

mods.when: Codex Adept (the devastator doctrine is active for this unit)
Bladeguard (once per turn, in the Fight phase, when selected to fight; instead of -1 to hit for attacks that target it)

marneus-calgar-wardens-of-ultramar-blade.why: Codex Adept (Marneus Calgar): the doctrines are active for this unit, the whole attached unit (19.04); Bladeguard: one of its two effects, once per turn.

Psychic Hood.def: Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks

Unyielding in the Face of the Foe.def: +1 to save rolls while it is controlling an objective
